semiconductor_relevance: High — AGD Corporation provides critical equipment components and sensors used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AGD Corporation, based in South Korea, specializes in providing equipment components and sensors for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include pneumatic equipment, non-contact temperature sensors, pressure sensors, and flow control components like valves and mass flow controllers. They also supply essential piping components, serving both domestic and international markets.
capabilities: Flow control components including valves and MFCs
Piping components such as tubing and connectors

regional_presence.Korea: Headquartered in South Korea with a manufacturing plant and research laboratory established since 2017.
